shared_elements: human figure(s) rendered in low relief
small repeated incised signs/symbols in the upper area
upright tapering/rounded-top slab format for the imagery
justification: Both surfaces depict human form in shallow relief with schematic arms/hands, incised horizontal bands and small repeated sign-like marks, but that is about as generic as anthropomorphic carving gets. A shows a single frontal, whole-body anthropomorphic figure built up from stacked schematic attributes (face, arms, pendant disc, belt bands), while B shows a narrative scene of two figures in strict profile facing one another across a laden offering table above ruled lines of script — different conventions, different composition, different relationships.
